name: d0cgxn-due-launch-gate
goal: Keep scheduled work out of unattended launch until the due time, then launch it through normal dispatch

evidence: Runs 1263 and 1264 started automatically about two hours after schedule-on, ahead of their stored due timestamps.
Tracker due-launch coverage only ticked the scheduler. It now enables the schedule and sweeps idle work before due; dispatcher coverage rechecks queued automatic claims and recovery.
Committed replay 49c242db33 failed: the watchdog set a launch token and the runner recorded later00001 as automatic before its due time.
The dispatcher reuses the scheduler due-time calculation for unattended admission. The native runner rechecks the stored due time before starting.
Clean snapshot 09c71be8cc passed the same ten tests. The watchdog left the item unqueued, it started as due at the exact time, and automatic claims and recovery respected the gate.
